bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
umask 077
p=/home/admin1/projects/debug-ai/.worktrees/independent-chat-20261128
sha=abb831082d0b858fad0563cce85babf7d5191a99
git -C "$p" fetch --no-tags origin "$sha"
test "$(git -C "$p" rev-parse FETCH_HEAD)" = "$sha"
tmp="$(mktemp -d)"
trap 'rm -rf -- "$tmp"' EXIT
git -C "$p" archive "$sha" server orchestrator | tar -x -C "$tmp"
chmod 755 "$tmp"
cid="$(docker ps -q --filter label=com.docker.compose.project=debug-ai --filter label=com.docker.compose.service=debug-ai)"
test -n "$cid"
image="$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$cid")"
docker run --rm --network none --read-only --tmpfs /tmp:rw,nosuid,nodev,size=64m --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --user 1000:1000 -v "$tmp/server:/app/server:ro" -v "$tmp/orchestrator:/app/orchestrator:ro" --entrypoint node "$image" --test server/tests/interactive-teaching.test.cjs server/tests/chat.test.cjs server/tests/chat-access.test.cjs
